deficit.heading: How large is Georgia’s budget deficit?
deficit.negative: A negative value indicates a deficit
deficit.caption: General government balance, {start}–{end}
deficit.forecastNote: The IMF projects the figures for 2026–2031. This WEO edition identifies 1995–2025 as the actual-data period.
deficit.source: Data: the International Monetary Fund’s (IMF) April 2026 World Economic Outlook.
deficit.definition: A negative value indicates a deficit and a positive value a surplus. The measure is the general government balance, rather than the difference between state-budget receipts and expenditure.
deficit.description: Georgia’s general government deficit or surplus, as a percentage of GDP and in nominal GEL, {first}–{last}.
deficit.datasetDescription: Georgia’s general government deficit or surplus, as a percentage of GDP and in nominal GEL, {first}–{last}; 2026–2031 are IMF projections.
